title: No line-up: Consumer Staples rising while the indexes are not
tag: None of my three lights line up today (lining up means my three signals point the same way). The tide (the trend of the four main index funds) is going out: none of the four closed above a rising trend line (a smoothed average of recent closes). The hot sector (the sector fund strongest against SPY) is Consumer Staples, rising while the tide goes out: a crosscurrent (a sector moving against the tide). Inside Consumer Staples, the strongest rising names are WMT, UL and PG.

convergence.summary: Today none of the three point the same way. My rules look for all three together.
items: Not lined up: the tide. None of the four index funds closed above a rising trend line.
